### AutoNation Appoints Ravi Simhambhatla Chief Technology and AI Officer


October 1, 2026


FORT LAUDERDALE, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


**AutoNation, Inc.** (NYSE: AN) today announced the appointment of Ravi Simhambhatla as Chief Technology and AI Officer, effective October 1, 2026. Mr. Simhambhatla will lead the Company’s technology, data science, and AI agenda.


Ravi Simhambhatla joins AutoNation as Chief Technology and AI Officer


"Over decades, we have built a portfolio of brands, physical infrastructure, and scale that have delivered consistently strong returns for our shareholders, and that would be nearly impossible to replicate today," said Mike Manley, Chief Executive Officer of AutoNation. "Technology, data science, and the intelligent use of AI give us the opportunity to get significantly more from that foundation: to raise the returns on our capital and extend our reach well beyond traditional geographic boundaries. That's why I'm delighted to welcome Ravi. From building an airline's systems from scratch to leading global technology at Avis Budget Group, he has turned technology into a competitive advantage at both start-up speed and global scale. His appointment is one of several steps we're taking to accelerate the growth of our business."


Ravi Simhambhatla brings more than 30 years of experience leading enterprise technology and digital transformation, with deep expertise in data, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, product innovation, and Customer experience. Most recently, as Executive Vice President and Chief Digital and Innovation Officer at Avis Budget Group, he led global technology, product, data, engineering, infrastructure, and cybersecurity while advancing the company’s adoption of AI and connected-fleet technology. He previously served as a Managing Director at Google Cloud, advising major enterprises on cloud, data, and AI transformation, and held senior technology leadership roles at United Airlines, overseeing commercial systems, digital commerce, loyalty, and revenue management.


Earlier in his career, Mr. Simhambhatla served as Chief Technology Officer at Aer Lingus, Vice President of Information Technology at Tesla, and Chief Information Officer at Virgin America, where he helped build the airline’s foundational digital and e-commerce platforms.


“I am honored to join AutoNation at an important point in the evolution of automotive retail,” said Ravi Simhambhatla. “With its tremendous scale, iconic brand, and talented Associates, AutoNation has a powerful platform for innovation. I look forward to working with the team to apply technology and AI in practical ways—making the Customer journey easier, equipping Associates with better tools and insights, and supporting the Company’s next phase of growth.”


**About AutoNation, Inc.**


AutoNation, one of the largest automotive retailers in the United States, offers innovative products and exceptional services as part of a portfolio of comprehensive solutions for our customers and their automotive needs. With a nationwide network of dealerships strengthened by a recognized brand, we offer a wide variety of new and used vehicles, customer financing, parts, and expert maintenance and repair services. Through DRV PNK, we have raised and donated over $50 million for cancer-related causes, demonstrating our commitment to making a positive difference in the lives of our Associates, Customers, and the communities we serve.
